build_depth_estimator_model: build a DepthEstimator model with backbone and decode_head configs for monocular depth estimation
extract_feat_backbone: extract feature maps from input images using the backbone network with optional category IDs
predict_depth_maps: predict depth estimation results from input images and return SegDataSample with pred_depth_map
calculate_training_losses: calculate training losses for decode head and optional auxiliary head from inputs and data samples
inference_slide_flip: run slide window inference with flip augmentation for high resolution depth estimation
